name: Daily AI summary of open issues
description: Every weekday at 08:00 (Europe/Berlin), fetches open GitHub issues, asks the configured LLM for a short prioritised summary, and posts it to chat. Requires FlowPilot:AI settings. Publish the workflow to activate the cron trigger.

config.system: You are a concise engineering lead. Reply in Slack markdown, at most 8 bullet points.

config.body: {{ ({ text: '*Daily issue report for ' + vars.repo + '* (' + nodes.slim.output.length + ' open)\n' + input.text }) }}
